turns.text: So Margaret tried to send a payment? No, Margaret, like, they tried to request a payment and Margaret didn't send it, so there's zero on the price who uses it
turns.margaret_text: Oh dear, I'm afraid I can't quite follow you. Who is this, and what payment are you asking about? I usually check with my daughter Priya before I press any buttons, so you'll have to go slowly with me.
Oh my, ten thousand dollars? That's a great deal of money, dear, and I don't even know who you are. I'd want to talk to Priya before I send anything like that.
